newsitem.title: USA: John Hancock offers variable annuity over phone.
newsitem.headline: John Hancock offers variable annuity over phone.

text.p: John Hancock Mutual Life Insurance Co said on Monday it introduced a no-load variable annuity that consumers can purchase over the phone.
John Hancock said it is the only top-ten life insurer to offer variable annuities direct to the consumer.
"The MarketPlace Variable Annuity broadens our ability to serve the varied buying patterns of today's consumers," John Hancock vice president Kathy Graveline said in a statement.
"Consumers now have two ways to buy annuities from Hancock," she said.

"For those who prefer to do business over the phone and direct their own investments, there's the MarketPlace Variable Annuity. Consumers who wants guidance, personalized asset allocation assistance and a face-to-face meeting can purchase variable annuities from a local Hancock marketing reprsentative," she said.

The new annuity will be test marketed in June in the central region of the United States, including: Arkansas, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, West Virginia and Wisconsin.
